props.description:
On odd rounds Deva guards in one of two stances, drawn at random: Vajra (higher Defense) or Maya (higher Magic Defense).

Every attack aimed at her, hit or miss, adds a Strike stack if it checked her Defense or a Magic stack if it checked her Magic Defense. On even rounds she takes the form the larger stack calls for, Fury or Focus, and the stacks reset.

She cannot be Provoked.
props.name: Celestial Discipline

props.description:
Two of her fists burn into being and hover over the field. Each one detonates on a random enemy on its second turn, dealing heavy Physical damage, unless it is broken first.

Each fist breaks after taking damage three times.

props.study_text: A deva of the high places who chose to kneel to Fafnir, and has never once explained why. She fights with fists of light that are not attached to anything, and she watches how you fight her before she decides how to fight you. Hit her with steel and she answers with steel. Hit her with spells and she takes the spells away.
props.traits: Arrogant · Devoted to Fafnir · Respects strength · Reads how you fight
